title: I'm Daniel Ortiz
subtitle: Front-End Development
about: Hi, my name is Daniel Ortiz, and I'm a web developer. I specialize in the main Front End development frameworks, such as Angular and Vue, although I also have basic knowledge of back-end frameworks such as Symphony and Django. I studied Computer Systems Engineering at the Universidad Privada del Norte (UPN). I'm self-taught, proactive, and easily adaptable to any project. My hobby is traveling the world and experiencing new cultures.
